This paragraph is deliberately allowed to run the full width of a desktop window without any maximum, so the measure comes out far past ninety-five characters per line, which is the point at which the eye starts losing its place on the return sweep and people stop reading long before they reach the end of the argument you were making. It repeats the same idea at length purely so that there is enough text here for the measure to be worth calculating at all, because a single short sentence would tell you nothing whatsoever about how the column actually reads.
